family: The single total threshold-two family defined in proof.md: f_0=0; for n>=1, f_n(x)=1 if and only if at least two coordinates of x are 1. The fixed linear-time evaluator and empty-witness NP verifier are as specified in proof.md.
theorem: For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n)>=(2)n-4 for every integer n>=3, and hence C_B2(f_n)>=(2)n-o(n), in the full Li-Yang B2 model at actual input length n=|x|.
